title: incident-bot: integrate SLO toolkit on-call helpers and telemetry hooks
author: Anya Patel
description: Add first-class on-call helper utilities to incident-bot and wire SLO Toolkit telemetry hooks to improve oncall diagnostics and runbook ranking. Motivation: during recent incidents we lacked concise oncall signals and the SLO toolkit produced disconnected telemetry. This PR introduces a small API for on-call responders (helpers package), integrates SLO Toolkit context into incident summaries, emits structured metrics for runbook scoring, and provides a documented opt-in feature flag for customers. Changes include backwards-compatible telemetry enrichment and a lightweight in-memory cache for runbook suggestions. Included: unit tests, integration tests against the slo-toolkit mock, docs and migration notes. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration test harness added [x] docs updated [x] feature flag gated rollout [x] changelog entry
